# Steampunk Ballista Turret

Public interactive Vite, TypeScript, and Three.js reconstruction of a stylized steampunk ballista.

Capabilities: orbit, zoom, part selection, full yaw, horizontal-centered pitch, exploded view, separate Fire and Crank & Load actions, complete reset, dark and light modes, cleaned source viewer, local GLB download, and responsive mobile controls.

Runtime: 245 physical mesh instances, 16,062 triangle faces, 28 semantic sculpt nodes, 13 selectable systems, four named sockets, and per-component collider and destruction metadata.

Truth boundary: code-built single-image reconstruction. Hidden geometry is inferred, projectile travel is visual, and no physics engine or audio is included.

Public site: Railway production URL in the GitHub repository homepage field.
